name: Poop Games
subtitle: Free games. Never any ads.
description: We all poop. We all go on our phone. Play these games instead of brainrotting. Never any ads. All features 100% free.
reviewNotes: No sign-in, payments, ads, tracking, or server connection. The dashboard opens to three games. Crossword retains daily newspaper grids and saved progress: tap New puzzle, then cells and letter keys. Word Guess Daily offers six guesses at a five-letter word, with colored feedback and local progress saved; a fresh word each local day. Galactic Raiders is an original arcade space shooter: tap Play, hold arrows to move and hold Fire to shoot. Pause/resume, waves, three lives, and a locally saved best score. All game content is bundled offline. No data is collected. Privacy/support opens the system browser.
